lines.t: Falling through the shadows again
Trying to hold my soul together
Heaven hear me tonight
Carry me through the storm
Late night riding with the weight on my chest
Mind moving fast but I still need rest
Dark clouds hanging while I fight through fear
Searching for peace while the pain stay near
Every road cold every memory burn
Still got faith while the whole world turn
Lost too much trying to carry my pride
Now I’m down on my knees with my hands to the sky
Voices keep calling trying to pull me low
But grace keep flowing like the river still flow
I was trapped in the dark where the sorrow grow
Now the light break through when the wind blow
When the wind blow
I can feel Your love around me
Through the darkness
You the only peace that found me
Every scar every broken road
Led me closer to Your soul
When the night cold
I still know I’m not alone
Trying to heal from the battles inside
Years of pain that I used to hide
Tears falling while I stare at the sky
Wondering why I survived this life
Still breathing still standing tall
Even when the world want me to fall
Mercy came when my faith got weak
Now the lost part of me finally free
Pressure heavy but my spirit rise
Truth cut deeper than the enemy lies
I was running too fast from the voice in my soul
Now I finally feel whole
Carry me
Wash away the fear inside of me
Hold me close when the night don’t sleep
Let Your peace fall over me
Seen too many people lose they way
Searching for love in the wrong escape
Money and pain got chains on souls
Everybody hurting nobody know
But I seen light break through despair
Felt hope move through the midnight air
Now every breath got purpose again
Every wound started learning to mend
No more running from who I am
Faith keep pulling me out that sand
Heart still scarred but I still believe
Grace got more for me
When the wind blow
I can hear heaven calling
Through the silence
Feel the weight of mercy falling
Every chain every heavy load
Ain’t mine to hold no more
When the storm comes
I still know what I’m fighting for
Ooooooh
Guide my soul through the night
Ooooooh
Lead me toward the light
